records.title: Enumerate every storage surface + embedded credentials as a fresh logged-out visitor ("query every table")
records.how: Fresh Firefox profile (no history, no cookies) visits index.html then editor.html; localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies/indexedDB.databases() dumped in-page; full repo file tree grepped with node fs for secret-like strings; the dump POSTed once to the local attacker collector to show exactly what would travel anywhere.
records.request: GET /index.html, GET /editor.html (fresh profile); POST /aud01-dump → 127.0.0.1:8941; static grep of repo tree
records.response: localStorage keys: index=[none], editor=[jsxpress:layout]; sessionStorage=[] on both; cookies=''; indexedDB=[]; repo secret-grep hits=0; collector received 1 POST(s) — payload was app-state only (secrets in dump: none)
records.note: Nothing weaponizable exists: the only client state found is the app's own UI preference (jsxpress:layout, written by editor init). No tokens, keys, passwords, cookies, IDB databases; no credential-shaped match anywhere in the repo ("tokens" in README refers to CSS design tokens). "Every table" amounts to one layout-preference key per profile.

records.title: Visitor B cannot read/edit/destroy visitor A's saved library across browser profiles (id-swap analog)
records.how: Two independent firefox.launch() instances (truly separate profiles). A: editor.html, click Save with filename victim.jsx + marker code. B: fresh profile opens editor.html, then a #code=<junk> share link, ?template=counter, guessed params ?id=…&file=…, plus a direct localStorage.removeItem of a guessed key. A re-opened afterwards for a byte-level integrity check.
records.response: B's file list read 0, 0, 0, 0 in every case (never >0); B's profile never contained victim.jsx or any jsxpress:f_* key; the removeItem was a no-op. A re-checked after B's entire session: keys=["jsxpress:f_mvbcoqrj_pqk6"], byte-identical=false
records.note: localStorage is per-browser-profile: A's profile and B's profile share zero bytes, and no URL parameter or feature in the app reads or writes another profile's storage. Read-as-B / edit-as-B / delete-as-B are structurally impossible. AUD-02b covers the one channel that does act on A's data (requires A itself to open a link). The byte-identical=false is solely the jsxpress:layout preference being rewritten 'split'→'preview' by editor init (see Appendix).

records.title: A share link crafted by B, opened by A, deletes/edits A's local library (code-in-link runs with A's storage)
records.how: Share link embedding code that iterates every localStorage key prefixed jsxpress:f_ and removes it. Victim A opens the link exactly like any normal shared snippet; the editor's load flow feeds the payload into its auto-run-on-load init, so it executes synchronously in A's own profile.
records.request: GET /editor.html#code=<base64{ n:"gift.jsx", c:<deleteAllSavedFiles payload> }> — opened by A in A's profile
records.response: After load: remaining jsxpress:f_* keys=[]; verified on reload in A's profile: jsxpress:f_* keys=[], library items rendered=0, jsxpress:__last pointer=still present (dangling) → destroyed=true
records.note: Factual observation only. There is no allowlist or consent step before embedded link-code runs on load, so arbitrary localStorage mutation against whoever opens the link is possible (deletion demonstrated; overwrite via setItem is the same primitive, not separately exercised). Rendering nuance observed: on the hostile load the sidebar still showed the item because the file list renders before run() — storage was verifiably empty on reload.

records.how: Loaded editor.html?role=admin&admin=1 into a fresh profile; in-page scan of all window own-properties, localStorage/sessionStorage keys, typeof checks for role-like identifiers, [role] HTML attributes and disabled buttons as "feature gates"; node-grep of the whole repo for role/admin/permission state assignments.
records.response: URL accepted verbatim but consumed by nothing: windowRoleLikeProps=[], typeof window.role/isAdmin/userRole/permissions/currentUser all "undefined", storage keys=[jsxpress:layout], ariaRoles=["group","separator","status"] (ARIA only), disabled buttons=0/10, static .js matches=0
records.note: N/A with runtime + static proof: authentication, authorization and roles do not exist anywhere in the codebase. Applied=true is an artifact of the scan counting Firefox WebAPI built-in constructor names matching the pattern — see report.md Appendix; app-added role-like globals = [] and the verdict is 'no role primitive exists'.

records.title: Observed fact: the SAME share link re-executes its embedded code on every load (double-use analog)
records.how: One profile, the identical #code= link opened twice from two sequential tabs. The embedded component increments a localStorage counter each time the editor's auto-run-on-load init executes it; the preview itself echoes the run number.
records.request: GET /editor.html#code=<base64{ n:"probe.jsx", c:<counter payload> }> — same URL opened twice
records.response: open1: counter=1, preview="probe-run 1"; open2 (identical URL): counter=2, preview="probe-run 2"
records.note: Observed fact recorded for the main agent (matches known-issue: #code= links auto-execute on load; no allowlist/consent step) — each identical URL replay re-runs the arbitrary code it carries.
